title: Kathryn Bernardo, Hidilyn Diaz honored by APEA as young leader, industry pioneer

blocks.text: Award-winning actress Kathryn Bernardo and Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz earned a spot on Asia-Pacific Entrepreneurs Annual Forum’s (APEA) 2026 Asia Pacific Young Leaders under 30 list and 2026 Asia-Pacific Industry Pioneers Under 35 list, respectively. The lists, which respectively recognize rising leaders and innovators under age 30 and 35, was released by the Hong Kong and Singapore-based organization on its Instagram page last Friday, Nov. 20. Bernardo joined the roster of personalities that included Zendaya, Billie Eilish, Chappell Roan, Sabrina Carpenter, Blackpink’s Jennie, and BTS’ Jungkook.
